# Muhammad Rezk — Senior Frontend Developer

> Personal portfolio of Muhammad Rezk (Mohamed Rezk), a Senior Frontend Developer with 5+ years of experience building high-performance, accessible web applications using Angular, TypeScript, React, and Next.js. Based in Alexandria, Egypt. Currently at SIGMA EMEA.
